2013 · Digital Photography, Photography

STORY BEHIND THE PROJECT. Although I am not a professional photographer, I love taking pictures and see the world from a different point of view. In June of 2013, I acquired a set of lens for my iPhone. The set includes a macro lens, which I have used the most for this project. With the help from the lens, I saw what I have been missing or have been ignoring for my whole life. I have been living in a world so big, I have forgotten about the little worlds around me. From dust on a car window to a cluster of moss on a tree trunk, there are so many stories behind them. I hope you enjoy looking at the project. And this is just part one.... -

2011 · Graphic Design, Photo Illustration

Illusion Another Collaboration with an amazing landscape photographer.

Two is better than one. It has always been a phrase that use to say to prove that team play is better than a solo player. A graphic designer like myself cannot survive alone. We need resources to make great art pieces and works. We need amazing stock pictures. And here, Thiha Soel, is a professional landscape photographer. His love for nature and wildness drew my attention and push my designing skills to mix my style with his 'natureness'. It was pretty difficult at first. I couldn't decide what to design. With the help of the internet and books and magazines, I get more inspirations and I finally had the chance to put up with this art piece. You can view amazing photos that are taken by Thiha Soul at http://thihasoul.com Hope you all like it. Cheers.
